en: Dependent on a state not associated with clinging (*na-upādinnam dhammam*), a state not associated with clinging arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state not dissociated from clinging (*na-anupādinnam dhammam*), a state not dissociated from clinging arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state not dissociated from clinging, a state not associated with clinging arises by way of the root condition. Dependent on a state not dissociated from clinging...
States that are neither-clung-to-nor-not-clung-to arise with root-condition.
Dependent on states that are neither-clung-to-nor-not-clung-to, a state that is not-clung-to arises with root-condition. (Abbreviated.
[There are] five under root, two under object, one under predominance … pe … one under repetition … pe … five under non-disappearance. (Full detail for all.)
The Great Pairs Section is finished.
